title: Good Day Sunshine | Stay On 30a – Luxury Beach Homes In 30a Florida
meta_description: Good Day Sunshine — a house in Seacrest Beach, Florida. 15 guests · 5 bedrooms · 4.5 bathrooms. Book direct with Stay on 30a.
description_expanded: Welcome to Good Day Sunshine, a bright and inviting coastal retreat designed for unforgettable days along 30A. Sleeping up to 15 guests and pet-friendly, this beautiful home is the perfect setting for family vacations, multi-family getaways, and groups who want to bring their four-legged family members along for the fun.Inside, spacious living areas and thoughtful coastal details create an effortless place to gather. The home features three king en-suite bedrooms, each offering a comfortable and private retreat, along with a dedicated bunk room that provides plenty of sleeping space for kids and additional guests. With room for up to 15, everyone can settle in comfortably while still having space to spread out.The open living and dining areas make time together easy, whether you're starting the morning over coffee, preparing dinner after a day at the beach, or gathering for a relaxed evening at home.Step outside and embrace the laid-back 30A lifestyle. Spend your mornings soaking up the Florida sunshine, your afternoons along the sugar-white sand, and your evenings enjoying dinner, drinks, and time together after sunset.Perfectly positioned for experiencing the best of 30A, Good Day Sunshine makes it easy to explore nearby beaches, scenic bike paths, local restaurants, boutique shopping, and the charming coastal communities that make this area so special.Whether you're planning long beach days, leisurely mornings, adventures along 30A, or simply enjoying time together with the whole family, pups included. Good Day Sunshine offers the space, comfort, and easygoing coastal atmosphere for a getaway you'll want to return to year after year.HOME HIGHLIGHTSPrivate Deeded Beach Access**Due to the Hurricane the private beach access will remain closed until the necessary repairs can be evaluated and completed and the structure is deemed safe for use.4 Adult BikesDog CrateHighchairPet Friendly *Additional $250 Fee Per Pet, Max of 2.Private Balconies with SeatingOutdoor Dining and Sitting AreasSmart TVsDedicated Work SpaceGas GrillBeach Tram Stop to HouseBeach GearParking Available Throughout the CommunityFull Sized Washer & DryerACCOMMODATIONSSleeps: 155 Bedrooms / 4.5 BathsFIRST FLOORBedroom 1: King Bed with EnsuiteHalf BathSECOND FLOORBedroom 2: King with EnsuiteBedroom 3: King with EnsuiteBedroom 4: KingBedroom 4: (2) Twin/Twin/Twin BunksTHIRD FLOORSofa with Twin TrundleWHAT WE OFFERA STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIESBody WashShampooConditionerHand SoapToilet PaperDish SoapDishwasher PodsLaundry DetergentPaper TowelsTrash BagsDish SpongeBath TowelsBed Linens |WELCOME BUNDLECoffee Grounds2 Keurig PodsPopcornOlive OilFiji WaterPARKINGParking available throughout the community first come first serve. Passes are required which will be provided by Seacrest security.Included are 4 bicycles (adult) for your convenience.SEACREST BEACH COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTSSeacrest Beach is one of the charming coastal communities that sits on 30A nestled between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Within the Seacrest community, there is a private beach and just 2 blocks away is the largest resort style family-friendly pool in Northern Florida with over 12,000 square feet of crystal-clear water. When you're ready to take a break from the pool and beach be sure to visit Peddlers Pavilion. Peddlers Pavilion is located in Seacrest Beach and is a collection of fun and unique businesses. Here you will find boutiques offering coastal attire to handmade jewelry. There are also some great local spots for dining. For additional entertainment shopping, dining and local events, take the Scenic 30A bike path to nearby Rosemary Beach, Florida.Please Note:*Seacrest Beach does not allow golf cart rentals.AMENITY ACCESSIn order to park and have access to Seacrest Beach amenities, guests are required to complete the online Seacrest Beach HOA Guest Registration packet, prior to their arrival. A link will be sent after the reservation is made. Upon arrival, you can pick up your parking passes and wristbands at the Guest Service Window by the lagoon pool. Guests can enter the lagoon area amenity complex at any of the six gates. There will be a queue outside of the Guest Services office marked by safety yellow beach umbrellas.BEACH ACCESSSeacrest Beach community features a private beach on the south side of 30A. There are tram stops throughout the community that operate on demand. Upon entering the beach to the left (east), there is onsite chair rental service. La Dolce Vita is the exclusive provider at Seacrest Beach. Guests may bring their own chairs to the beach for set up on the right (west) side of the beach. Prohibited items at the private beach access: wagons, wheeled coolers, tents, and canopies.HOUSE RULES*Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM*Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises.*No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck.*No parties or events.*During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi.*Additional $250 Fee Per Pet, Max of 2.IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVALAll guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver s license and 2) a "selfie".Other things to note
